name: [VALENTINE!] CONTROL
desc:
In this game, you play as a C.T.R.L employee trapped inside a sealed research facility after a sudden lockdown. Containment is failing, entities are becoming unstable, and danger is spreading through the halls. Stay alert, manage your resources, and survive until help arrives.

[✅] Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

[🎧] Use headphones and max graphics for a better experience. 

Inspired by "SCP: Containment Breach" / "Five Nights at Freddy's." / "L. Corporation."
